name: sweetiebot-scm
description: Local semantic and hybrid workspace search in the Source Control sidebar using Ollama.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only the workspace trust guide is available in Restricted Mode. Git operations, indexing, and background services require workspace trust.

commands.title: Squash Selected Pull Requests with ChatGPT

scmToolkit.automaticBranchCleanup.description: Automatically remove eligible merged local branches on startup and every ten minutes.

scmToolkit.cloudRepositorySync.description: Sync existing local main checkouts every 15 minutes when upstream main has commits in the past seven days, even after VS Code closes. Skips local changes and divergence.

scmToolkit.durableBackgroundCommits.description: Commit staged changes locally at once with a placeholder, then apply the generated message and optionally push in the background, with restart recovery. Off uses the earlier direct commit workflow.

scmToolkit.automaticWorkspaceCleanup.description: Prune Sweetiebot-managed, inactive independent workspaces only when their verified pull requests merged into main and no dirty files, unmerged branches, or unpublished commits remain. Does not touch legacy workspaces.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.autoReindex.description: Automatically refresh the workspace search index every two minutes.

scmToolkit.autoPublishNewBranches.description: Automatically publish newly selected local branches to the configured Git remote.

scmToolkit.startCompactPRSession.description: Open a dedicated pull-request session window in the compact 600px square layout.

scmToolkit.compactWindowButton.description: Show the compact-window sizing button in the title bar.

scmToolkit.newWorkspaceWindowButton.description: Show a title-bar button that opens an independent local Git checkout on main in a new window.

scmToolkit.promptForIndependentWorkspace.description: Offer VS Code's native trust dialog for the Sweetiebot Workspaces parent folder. Approval covers all existing and future clones. Use Configure Independent Workspace Trust to reopen it.

scmToolkit.codexKeepAwake.description: Keep macOS awake while Codex is working. Releases idle-sleep prevention when all tasks finish; the display can still turn off.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.embeddingMode.description: Ollama embedding model used to index and search workspace content.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.askOllama.description: Show the Ask Ollama action. Requires an explicit chat model.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.chatModel.description: Ollama chat model used by Ask Ollama. Required when Ask Ollama is enabled.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.placeholder.description: Hint shown in the empty EFS search box; set to SATS or any custom text. Leave blank to restore the original hint.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.ollamaUrl.description: Loopback Ollama server URL. Only localhost and loopback addresses are accepted.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.mode.description: Default ranking mode. Hybrid combines semantic and exact term matching.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.resultLimit.description: Maximum number of result passages shown.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of workspace files considered for indexing.

scmToolkit.workspaceSearch.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum file size indexed directly. External document extractors may still impose their own limits.

scmToolkit.openPanelOnStartup.description: Open Sweetie Bot / Source Control when each VS Code window starts, then return keyboard focus to the editor.

scmToolkit.pullRequestAutoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh visible and focused GitHub PR lists at the configured interval (120 seconds by default), pausing on rate limits.

scmToolkit.pullRequestQuickMerge.description: Show an inline button to squash-merge a GitHub pull request into its base branch, confirming non-main targets.

scmToolkit.chatgptProjectUrl.description: Optional ChatGPT project URL used when opening PR drafting and batch squash-merge prompts. Blank opens a normal ChatGPT chat. Example: https://chatgpt.com/g/g-p-.../project.

scmToolkit.automaticAppRepair.description: Automatically install Sweetie Bot updates from main, restore customizations, and reload stale windows after updates settle. Background windows reload when focused.

scmToolkit.messagePlaceholder.description: Text shown in the Source Control commit-message box. Leave blank to use VS Code's default.

scmToolkit.sourceControlLabel.description: Source Control panel and Activity Bar label. Save in Sweetiebot settings to apply through automatic app repair and reload.

scmToolkit.commitButtonLabel.description: Text shown on the primary Source Control commit action.

scmToolkit.commitAndSendButtonLabel.description: Text shown on the primary commit action when git.postCommitCommand is push.

scmToolkit.hideIncomingSyncArrow.description: Hide the incoming (down) arrow in the Source Control Sync button without hiding its count or changing Git operations.

scmToolkit.hideOutgoingSyncArrow.description: Hide the outgoing (up) arrow in the Source Control Sync button without hiding its count or changing Git operations.

scmToolkit.incomingSyncLabel.description: Optional custom label beside the incoming (down-arrow) Sync Changes count. Blank keeps the native display.

scmToolkit.outgoingSyncLabel.description: Optional custom label beside the outgoing (up-arrow) Sync Changes count. Blank keeps the native display.

scmToolkit.kefaniaShowCloseButton.description: Show the X to close a published Kefania confirmation window.

scmToolkit.kefaniaCloseButtonLeft.description: Place the white Kefania confirmation X in the upper-left corner instead of the right.

scmToolkit.autoPublishPullRequests.description: Automatically publish completed Kefania PR drafts without text confirmation. Pony research finishes independently.

scmToolkit.pullRequestRefreshIntervalSec.description: Seconds between automatic PR list refreshes (30–3600). Manual refresh is unaffected.
